summary: Iteration 32 — End-to-end testing of the new Messages feature (announcements + reminders, threading, banners, role-based send rules) across backend + frontend. Backend pytest: 11/11 pass (6 original test_messages.py + 5 new test_messages_extra.py covering reminder-cannot-be-dismissed, get_thread 403 for non-participants, replies fan-out + delete cascade, banners urgent-first ordering + 5-cap, sent-folder listing + sender excluded from own recipients). Frontend E2E: verified super_admin & office_admin compose dialogs, list/sent tabs, thread-view + reply send, AnnouncementBanners stack (5 active urgent-first on office_admin dashboard), banner dismiss (5→4 visible), banner-open routes to /messages/<id>, BottomNav 'Messages' on mobile (390x844), unread-count API returns {count:6}. Cross-role flow validated: super_admin sent 'E2E Announcement to Users' (toast 'Sent to 1 recipient(s)'); office_admin sent peer announcement (toast 'Sent to 2 recipient(s)'). Regression: /, /transactions, /accounts, /clients, /students, /messages, /settings all load. Bell badge increments correctly (showed 7 on office_admin).

critical_code_review_comments: messages.py router is clean — 363 lines, single-responsibility, proper RBAC via _validate_send + _enforce_recipient_role, MongoDB _id excluded via projection on every find. Notif fan-out uses bulk_persist_and_push (existing util).
Banner sort logic (line 248) uses a fragile string-key sort by stripping ISO date chars — works, but a tuple of (priority_rank, -created_at_unix) would be cleaner. Non-blocking.

User-role 'compose-picker-opt-<userId>' options only render after typing in compose-picker-search (lazy filter). Acceptable UX, but consider auto-listing super_admins on first open to reduce friction. Non-blocking.
Backend tests cover all 3 roles × 2 kinds × audience permutations (12 paths) with explicit 403 assertions. Notif fan-out + cascade delete verified.

Pre-existing benign 401s on /api/notifications + /api/users/me during initial page boot (cookie attaches a beat after the first axios call). Already noted in iteration_31 — not caused by Messages feature.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Messages feature is production-ready. Backend 11/11 pytest pass. Frontend verified across super_admin + office_admin (user role frontend not tested directly — but covered by backend test_user_reminds_super_admin_and_threading). To test user role frontend, create a User account via super_admin POST /api/users then login; the compose dialog should show ONLY reminder toggle and picker should list super_admins. AnnouncementBanners (5-cap, urgent-first) verified on office_admin dashboard with 5 banners visible — they appear correctly at top above 'Good night, BLR.' greeting. Banner dismiss is per-user via acks.{userId}.dismissed_at. The 4 pre-existing 401 console errors (notifications poll before cookie attaches) are unchanged from prior iterations.
